title: Threshing in a Winepress
text: … where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.

title: Hide It from the Midianites
text: Whenever the Israelites planted their crops, the Midianites, Amalekites, and other people of the east would come up and invade them …

title: Like a Swarm of Locusts
text: For the Midianites came with their livestock and their tents like a great swarm of locusts.

title: Greatly Impoverished
text: Israel was greatly impoverished by Midian, and the Israelites cried out to the LORD.

title: The Israelites Cried Out
text: Now when the Israelites cried out to the LORD because of Midian …

title: He Sent Them a Prophet
text: … He sent them a prophet …

title: Mighty Man of Valor
text: The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.

title: Where Are His Wonders?
text: … if the LORD is with us, why has all this happened to us? And where are all His wonders of which our fathers told us …

title: Go in the Strength You Have
text: Go in the strength you have and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Am I not sending you?

title: The Weakest Clan
text: Indeed, my clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my father’s house.

title: I Will Be with You
text: Surely I will be with you, | and you will strike down all the Midianites as one man.

title: Give Me a Sign
text: If I have found favor in Your sight, give me a sign that it is You speaking with me.

title: A Young Goat and Unleavened Bread
text: So Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened bread and an ephah of flour.

title: Lay Them on the Rock
text: Take the meat and the unleavened bread, lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.

title: Fire Flared from the Rock
text: And fire flared from the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened bread.

title: Face to Face
text: Oh no, Lord GOD! I have seen the angel of the LORD face to face!

title: Peace Be with You
text: Peace be with you. Do not be afraid, for you will not die.

title: The LORD Is Peace
text: So Gideon built an altar to the LORD there and called it The LORD Is Peace.

title: On That Very Night
text: On that very night the LORD said to Gideon …

title: Tear Down Your Father's Altar
text: … tear down your father’s altar to Baal, and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.

title: A Proper Altar
text: Then build a proper altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold.

title: Too Afraid to Do It by Day
text: But because he was too afraid of his father’s household and the men of the city, he did it by night rather than in the daytime.

title: Who Did This?
text: Who did this?

title: Let Him Contend for Himself
text: If Baal is a god, let him contend for himself with the one who has torn down his altar.

title: Jerubbaal
text: So on that day Gideon was called Jerubbaal, that is to say, “Let Baal contend with him,” because he had torn down Baal’s altar.

title: If You Are Going to Save Israel
text: If You are going to save Israel by my hand, as You have said …

title: A Fleece of Wool
text: … then behold, I will place a fleece of wool on the threshing floor.

title: Dew Only on the Fleece
text: If there is dew only on the fleece and all the ground is dry, then I will know that You are going to save Israel by my hand …

title: A Bowlful of Water
text: When Gideon arose the next morning, he squeezed the fleece and wrung out the dew—a bowlful of water.

title: Do Not Be Angry with Me
text: Do not be angry with me; let me speak one more time.

title: Only the Fleece Was Dry
text: And that night God did so. Only the fleece was dry, and dew covered the ground.

title: Dew on the Ground
text: This time let it be dry, and the ground covered with dew.

title: My Peace I Give to You
text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you.

title: Ten Servants
text: So Gideon took ten of his servants and did as the LORD had told him.

title: A Prophet Sent
text: I delivered you out of the hands of Egypt and all your oppressors. I drove them out before you and gave you their land.

title: Shelters in the Mountains
text: Because of the Midianites, the Israelites prepared shelters for themselves in the mountains, caves, and strongholds.

title: A Great Swarm
text: For the Midianites came with their livestock and their tents like a great swarm of locusts.
